title: TCG's Arsenal
description: wowie! an anchor retexture to the anchorblade! so original!
body:
## Have you ever wanted your Anchorblade to look different?
Well now it can be!

Its now a distinct red color with a little tan grip.

## Why should I have this?
Cause it looks cool and it supports me and my efforts of doing more stuff like this

## I want to suggest stuff! Where do I do that?
Go to the discord linked here. its as shrimple as that.

## What else are you making?
You'll just have to wait and see...
